reason: The knob is LIVE in exp70g. Cell 0 sets BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE=0.965 and cell 2 binds it. Cell 3 hard-sets only SECONDARY_*/DUAL_SEED_*. Cell 7 readmit_discarded_detections gates on `peaks['score'] >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE` inside OUTPUT_MOTION_RELINK (on) before the second relink. The cell-12 PP override is off (VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0). lowrefine reads the same env var, and its pool feeds only readmit and gapfill; divinsert does not use it. safetail turns readmit off only after the deadline. The knob is not on the closed list (READMIT_RADIUS is), both arms stay inside 1.5% of nodes (down +0.84% in the exp85c dummy, up about -0.3%), and runtime is flat. So it is not dead and not negligible. It fails on slot value. (1) The DOWN arm largely repeats P50 (exp85a, pending). F-TRN-56 says almost all of exp85a's output change comes from READMIT 0.94: 122,328 nodes vs 122,274 for exp85c, while ILP 0.4 alone adds +49 net nodes and 3 safe forks. A separate exp85c slot only helps if P50 reads flat or down and we need to split READMIT from ILP. (2) The UP arm (0.99) reads a sign that has already been disclosed. 743929 (same x138 defaults) got +0.001 from lowering 0.965 to 0.94, and says its best lever 'moved exactly one thousandth in each direction around the base'. The up arm's expected read is at or below the base, so it can never be a finals candidate, and P50 makes it redundant. If P50 is UP, the next step is further down (exp86c = ILP 0.4 + READMIT 0.92, already built and gated). If P50 is flat or down, exp85c is the decomposing read, not 0.99. (3) Readmits are 3.5-6x depleted near GT in-sample (F-TRN-55), so the [0.965,0.99) quarter that 0.99 removes may not show on the 3-decimal display at all. Verdict: do not spend two of the last slots on this pair. Drop 0.99, and keep the down direction conditional on the P50 read.
fixed_values: UP arm 0.99: drop it (sign already disclosed as 'lower is better'; dominated by P50). DOWN: keep 0.94 (exp85c, built, dummy PASS +0.84% nodes, 82 forks) only if P50/exp85a reads flat or down, to separate READMIT from ILP 0.4. If P50 reads UP, the next step is 0.92 (exp86c = exp70g + ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4 + READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.92, gate PASS, +0.32% nodes vs exp85a), not 0.99.
